source.reuse: Existing contextual door plate and pointing-hand engraving; no new donor bytes.

shopCases.name: Shop Open, Close and Take use one timber action and exact portal/object commands
Space respects focus: a prompt activates itself and a stick press uses the tool
Unavailable, disabled and offscreen shop context cannot be invoked
A held shop press cannot retarget, even after the same action disappears and returns
Pickup disappearance restores stick focus and does not spend a throwable
Pause hides the shop action, discards its old press and restores a valid prompt
Pending, active and cancelling throwable aim suppress the shop prompt
Death and lost projection hide the plate without stealing unrelated focus
Shop prompt fits around the deck, plan, vitals and zoom controls at viewport edges

browser.scope: Native mouse and keyboard on the production HUD with controlled v1 snapshots and an SVG background; no WebGL or physical handset. Synthetic touch covers pointer routing.
